notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Added a new "max" button that allows to spend all multiplier points at once and buy a bunch of multipliers instantly.

Tutorial update. Added information about all multipliers.

Fixed leaderboard panel. Now all names and scores are displayed properly.
